name: qplaze-sync-worker
description: Standalone Node/Playwright worker that scrapes cards from a Kanboard instance and syncs them into the main app via a Supabase RPC. Deployed separately from the main Vite app (Railway) — Supabase Edge Functions cannot run Playwright.

scripts.sync-once: node -e "import('./src/sync.js').then(m => m.runSync().then(r => { console.log(r); process.exit(0) }).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1) }))"
